title: 第五章 灯影初逢第六章 月夜惊鸿
slug: 穿书被杀妻证道魔尊追妻夜夜哄
content_zh:
“掌柜的，您没看错？”伙计惊地快瞪大双眼。
灵宝阁掌柜强压下心头骇浪，低声道：“这等品相的戒指，四海八荒绝不出三枚之数。多年前老夫曾有幸得见一枚碧玉成色的，眼前这枚紫翡虽被大能施术掩去七分光华，可那通体流转的道韵绝不会错。”
他眼底精光一闪即逝，“等下你配合我，这戒指不仅能纳须弥于芥子，更可挡合体巅峰期以下全力一击，据说还藏着玄机，今日若能套出一星半点的秘辛，怕是比做成十桩买卖都值。”
“放心，掌柜。”伙计应声后匆匆离开。
掌柜随后走了出来，笑道：“仙子久等了，再下才将这层机关关掉。您这边请，这边请！正巧这有一尊上好的丹炉。”他利落地打开镌刻着防护阵纹的多宝柜，小心翼翼地从锦缎衬垫上捧出一尊三足丹炉。
谢清猗凑近细看，炉身上的云纹像是在缓缓游走。她伸手探去，指腹触及之处只有冰凉，而那纹路却纹丝不动，原是灵气流转造成的错觉。
她微微抿唇，还真是神奇。
“此乃仙品灵器中的极品丹炉。”掌柜指尖轻抚过镌刻的云纹，抬头时，眼中微光一闪：“仙子，您看这些聚灵纹，实在是不可多得的精品！”
随后，炉盖开启，一股灵气精纯的淡淡药香扑面而来，在炉内壁弥漫着晶莹的光泽。
谢清猗微微俯身，抬手间，运起一丝灵力探查，炉内顿时泛起冰蓝辉光。
果然如掌柜所言，这丹炉能凝聚天地灵气，对成丹确有裨益，她忍不住开口询问：“多少灵石？”
“两万上品灵石。”掌柜眼尾的细纹愈发明显，笑吟吟地报出数目。
如今修仙界高阶炼丹师凤毛麟角，这等品级的丹炉在中低阶炼丹师眼中可是梦中情鼎，但在顶尖炼丹师眼里又稍显寻常，着实是有价无市。
见少女对这丹炉爱不释手，掌柜心中暗喜，正要再添把火，却听她轻叹一声：“太贵了……”
那纤纤玉指恋恋不舍地从炉身滑落，“我还是随便逛逛罢。”
就在她转身欲走之际，一个伙计疾步上前，在掌柜耳边低语数句，掌柜神色骤变，眸光颤动，慌忙唤道：“仙子留步！”
“老板，我是真买不起……”她精致的小脸皱成一团。
掌柜连连摆手：“价钱好商量！您，您看着给便是！”说罢竟抬手抱起那炼丹炉要往她怀中放。
“当真？那……那一万上品灵石，可以吗”她灵动的美眸瞬间被惊喜点亮，说着手指还比个数。
“就依仙子所言！”掌柜暗自松了口气，那位既然示意任由她开价，这个数目应当无妨，想起刚才传来的警告，他仍心有余悸。

他借着躬身动作拭去额间薄汗，心中暗凛，幸而未露贪念，否则，思及此，他不由打了个寒颤，愈发谨小慎微地侍立一旁。
谢清猗有些奇怪掌柜为何会冒汗，一般修行者都不易受气温影响，但她并未多想，还是爽快地取出一万上品灵石，虽肉疼得很，却自觉捡了大便宜，眉眼间尽是藏不住的欢欣。
掌柜双手接过灵石，立即躬身笑道：“小店另备了些上等灵植，聊表心意，还望仙子笑纳。”他转头朝伙计使了个眼色。
不过片刻，便见伙计捧着个锦盒快步走来，盒中灵植灵气充沛，枝叶舒展，隐隐有宝光流转，果然都是难得一见的珍品。
“仙子可还有别的需要？”掌柜小心翼翼地询问，袖中的手不自觉攥紧了汗巾。
“这些便够了，多谢掌柜。”谢清猗勾唇一笑收好东西，步履轻快地离去。
掌柜目送那道倩影远去，融入门外璀璨灯火与人潮之中，这才长舒一口气，低声嘱咐身旁的伙计：“往后这位仙子光临，务必要比伺候老祖宗更上心。”
赠出的皆是极品灵植，但愿那位莫要怪罪，想起那人的手段，他不禁打了个寒颤，摇着头踱回店内。
谢清猗沿着青石板铺就的长街悠然踱步，两旁摊贩的吆喝声此起彼伏，悬在檐下的灯笼洒下暖黄光晕，映照着往来行人的身上。
正寻思着找间饭馆填饱肚子，忽被一股诱人香气勾住了脚步，是热腾腾的饭菜香味！
谢清猗激动得几乎要跳起来，循香进了路旁的’溪山宴居’。
此时，天色已沉，二楼雅间支起了菱花窗，楼下大堂正是热闹的时候，跑堂托着木盘在桌椅间灵活穿梭，她心中一叹，看来修仙界也有人间的烟火气息。
大堂里内，十来盏以月光石雕琢的莲花灯浮在半空，倾泻出柔和的光晕，散坐着几桌修士，有在低声说着秘闻，或高声谈笑着。有人在说北洲的新秘境要开启了，或是南洲出土的灵器，还有修士抱怨最近丹药太贵，伴随着杯盏轻碰声与丝竹之音传入她耳中。
晚风穿过窗棂带着淡淡的玉兰香，灯笼随之轻轻摇曳，眼前的一切，让谢清猗恍惚了一瞬，修仙界的饭馆和凡间也没什么两样。
content_en:
"Shopkeeper, are you reading that correctly?" The waiter's eyes widened in shock.
The shopkeeper of Lingbao Pavilion suppressed the panic in his heart and whispered: "There are no more than three rings of this quality in all the world. Many years ago, I was lucky enough to see a jasper-colored one. Although the purple jadeite in front of me has been covered up by the powerful magic, the Taoist charm that flows through it is unmistakable."
The light in his eyes flashed, "Wait a minute if you cooperate with me, this ring can not only absorb the mustard seeds, but also block a full-strength blow below the peak of the body. It is said that it also hides a secret. If I can find out even a little bit of the secret today, I'm afraid it will be worth ten deals."
"Don't worry, shopkeeper." The waiter responded and left in a hurry.
The shopkeeper then came out and said with a smile: "The fairy has been waiting for a long time before turning off this layer of mechanism. Please come here, please come here! It just so happens that there is a good alchemy furnace here." He neatly opened the treasure cabinet engraved with protective array patterns, and carefully took out a three-legged alchemy furnace from the brocade lining.
Xie Qingyi took a closer look and saw that the cloud patterns on the furnace seemed to be slowly moving around. She stretched out her hand to explore, and there was only coldness where her fingertips touched, but the lines did not move at all. It was an illusion caused by the flow of spiritual energy.
She pursed her lips slightly, it was really magical.
"This is the best alchemy furnace among the immortal spiritual weapons." The shopkeeper's fingertips gently touched the engraved cloud patterns. When he raised his head, a glimmer of light flashed in his eyes: "Fairy, look at these spirit gathering patterns, they are really rare and exquisite!"
Then, the furnace lid was opened, and a faint medicinal fragrance of pure spiritual energy came to the face, filling the inner wall of the furnace with a crystal luster.
Xie Qingyi leaned forward slightly, raised his hand, and used a trace of spiritual power to explore, and the furnace suddenly glowed with an icy blue glow.
Sure enough, as the shopkeeper said, this pill furnace can condense the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, which is indeed beneficial to the formation of pills. She couldn't help but ask: "How many spiritual stones?"
"Twenty thousand high-grade spiritual stones." The fine lines at the end of the shopkeeper's eyes became more and more obvious, and he reported the number with a smile.
Nowadays, there are very few high-level alchemists in the world of immortality. This level of alchemy furnace is like a dream cauldron in the eyes of middle and low-level alchemists, but in the eyes of top alchemists, it is a bit ordinary, and it is really priceless.
Seeing that the girl couldn't put it down, the shopkeeper was secretly happy. He was about to add more fire, but he heard her sigh softly: "It's too expensive..."
The slender jade fingers reluctantly slipped from the furnace body, "I'd better just take a stroll."
Just as she turned around to leave, a waiter stepped forward quickly and whispered a few words into the shopkeeper's ear. The shopkeeper's expression suddenly changed, his eyes trembled, and he hurriedly called out: "Fairy, stay here!"
"Boss, I really can't afford it..." Her delicate little face wrinkled.
The shopkeeper waved his hands repeatedly: "The price is negotiable! You can give it to me as long as you like!" After saying that, he raised his hand and picked up the alchemy furnace to put it in her arms.
"Seriously? Then... can you take ten thousand high-grade spiritual stones?" Her beautiful eyes were instantly lit up by surprise, and she counted them with her fingers as she spoke.
"Just as the fairy said!" The shopkeeper secretly breathed a sigh of relief. Since that person indicated that she was allowed to set the price, the amount should be fine. Thinking of the warning just now, he was still frightened.
He wiped the thin sweat from his forehead by bowing, and felt a chill in his heart. Fortunately, he did not reveal his greed. Otherwise, thinking about this, he couldn't help but shudder, and stood aside more cautiously.
Xie Qingyi was a little surprised why the shopkeeper was sweating. Practitioners in general were not easily affected by the temperature, but she didn't think much about it and readily took out 10,000 high-grade spiritual stones. Although her body hurt a lot, she felt that she had gotten a big deal, and she could not hide the joy in her eyes.
The shopkeeper took the spirit stone with both hands and immediately bowed and said with a smile: "The shop has prepared some high-quality spiritual plants. I hope the fairy will accept it." He turned his head and winked at the waiter.
Within a moment, I saw a waiter walking quickly with a brocade box in his hands. The spiritual plants in the box were full of spiritual energy, their branches and leaves were stretched out, and there was a faint treasure light flowing around them. They were indeed rare treasures.
"Do you have any other needs, Fairy?" the shopkeeper saidHe asked cautiously, and the hands in his sleeves unconsciously tightened the sweat towel.
"That's enough, thank you, shopkeeper." Xie Qingyi put away the things with a crooked smile and left briskly.
The shopkeeper watched the beautiful figure go away and merge into the bright lights and crowds outside the door. Then he breathed a sigh of relief and whispered to the waiter beside him: "When this fairy comes from the future, he must be more attentive than serving our ancestors."
The gifts were all top-quality spiritual plants, and he hoped that that person would not be blamed. Thinking of that person's methods, he couldn't help but shudder, and walked back to the store, shaking his head.
Xie Qingyi walked leisurely along the long street paved with bluestone slabs. The shouts of vendors on both sides could be heard one after another. The lanterns hanging under the eaves cast a warm yellow halo, reflecting the bodies of passers-by.
I was thinking about finding a restaurant to fill my stomach when I was suddenly attracted by an alluring aroma. It was the aroma of hot food!
Xie Qingyi was so excited that he almost jumped up and walked into the "Xishan Yanju" on the roadside.
At this time, the sky was already dark, and the private room on the second floor had a diamond-shaped window. The lobby downstairs was bustling, and the waiting room was carrying wooden trays flexibly among the tables and chairs. She sighed in her heart, it seems that the world of immortality also has the atmosphere of human fireworks.
In the lobby, a dozen lotus lanterns carved from moonstone floated in mid-air, pouring out a soft halo of light. There were several tables of monks sitting scattered around, some whispering secrets, or talking loudly and laughing. Some people were saying that a new secret realm was about to be opened in Beizhou, or about spiritual weapons unearthed in Nanzhou, and some monks were complaining that elixirs were too expensive recently, and the sound of cups and cups and the sound of silk and bamboo reached her ears.
The evening breeze carried the faint fragrance of magnolia through the window lattice, and the lantern swayed gently. Everything in front of him made Xie Qingyi feel dazed for a moment. The restaurant in the world of immortality was no different from the mortal world.
